mapper.insert: INSERT INTO permission (name, code, type, parent_id, path, icon, sort_order, status, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{type}, #{parentId}, #{path}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM permission WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM permission ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT p.* FROM permission p JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM permission p JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1
